assumptions.claim: factory is a deployed contract implementing IRaffleFactory.raffleImplementation() and IRaffleFactory.isRaffle(address) without reverting.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.constructor (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L89-L91) deploys Raffle with factory = msg.sender (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L161), and Raffle.constructor (L155-L166) does not invoke _isProtocolDestination while RaffleFactory is still under construction.

assumptions.claim: prizeToken_ is the non-zero configured prize token for the raffle so that destination == prizeToken_ rejects the prize token rather than address(0).
assumptions.establishedBy: Raffle.initialize checks params.prizeToken != address(0) (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L183-L185) before calling _isProtocolDestination (L187-L195) and stores prizeToken (L200), which Raffle._update (L498) and Raffle._transferQuote (L565) subsequently pass.

assumptions.claim: Every registered Raffle clone in canonicalFactory.isRaffle has destination.code.length != 0 when _isProtocolDestination is called, so gating the registry lookup on destination.code.length != 0 (L602) never skips a registered clone.
assumptions.establishedBy: RaffleFactory.createRaffle deploys the 45-byte ERC-1167 clone via Clones.clone(raffleImplementation) (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L106, Clones.sol:L54-L57) before setting isRaffle[raffle] = true (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L125), and neither Clones.sol nor Raffle.sol contains selfdestruct.

assumptions.claim: An address for which _isProtocolDestination(destination, prizeToken_) returns false during Raffle.initialize (L187-L195) or Raffle._update (L498) will continue to have _isProtocolDestination return false at later claim/payout times (Raffle._transferQuote at L565, Raffle.redeemWinningTicket at L334, or Raffle.releaseSponsorPrize at L404) and across later Raffle.initialize calls (L190).
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (a precomputed future CREATE address of RaffleFactory at Clones.sol:L57 has code.length == 0 and isRaffle[destination] == false before RaffleFactory.createRaffle reaches that nonce, and has code.length == 45 and isRaffle[destination] == true after RaffleFactory.sol:L106, L125).

calls.propagates: Returns the immutable raffleImplementation address set in RaffleFactory.constructor (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L89-L91); called at Raffle.sol:L601 whenever destination does not equal address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), or prizeToken_.

Returns the current boolean value of RaffleFactory.isRaffle[destination], which is set to true in RaffleFactory.createRaffle (packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L125) after clone deployment (L106) and initialization (L109-L121); called at Raffle.sol:L603 only when unsafeDestination is false after L601 and destination.code.length != 0 (L602).

invariants.claim: Returns true if and only if destination equals address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), prizeToken_, canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation(), or has destination.code.length != 0 and canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) == true at the moment of evaluation.

During Raffle.initialize (L187-L195), _isProtocolDestination rejects the newly deployed clone's own address via destination == address(this) even though canonicalFactory.isRaffle(address(this)) is not set to true until RaffleFactory.sol:L125.
Does not invoke canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) when destination.code.length == 0 or when destination already matched one of the six singleton protocol addresses.

sharedState: Raffle.prizeToken (packages/contracts/src/Raffle.sol:L70, passed by callers _update at L498 and _transferQuote at L565)
